principle: Stores POINTERS ONLY. Never store canonical source content in this repository. On any mismatch between version_pin and the retrieved live document, THE LIVE DRIVE DOCUMENT WINS.
resolution_rules: Resolve every source by file_id. Never resolve by title search: titles change to 'LEGACY - <title> - Superseded <date> (vX.Y)' when a document is superseded, but the canonical document keeps its file_id and is edited in place.
Reject any retrieval whose live title begins with 'LEGACY -' or 'ARCHIVED -'. Stop and re-resolve.
Read the retrieved document's own version/date line and compare to version_pin.
version_pin mismatch => status REGISTRY DRIFT: proceed on the live document, raise an Improvement Finding, do not proceed on the pin.
Retrieval failure on a required source => HOLD for the policy-dependent portion of the task only.
Access is proven by retrieval, never inferred from folder sharing. Canonical files are split across two owner accounts.

authority_levels.controlling: The SOP that controls this specific workflow.
authority_levels.canonical-prompt: The approved business logic for an agent. Retrieved at runtime and followed; never copied into this repository.
authority_levels.supporting: Referenced by a canonical prompt as a controlling source for part of its workflow.
authority_levels.route-target: Named as a handoff destination. POINTER ONLY - do not retrieve during a normal run.
authority_levels.canonical-template: An approved client-facing master asset. Retrieved as the structural and brand reference. NEVER overwritten - client work is always a copy.
